0022600004.text: Both the Minnesota Timberwolves and the Miami Heat open their 2026-27 seasons in this regular-season game, which is on the road for Minnesota. The Timberwolves will be without Donte DiVincenzo, who is out following Achilles surgery, and Ayo Dosunmu is day-to-day with a rest designation and a game-time decision. Minnesota won both meetings with Miami in the 2025-26 season, including a 122-94 win in Minneapolis on January 6, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Timberwolves a 50% chance to win.
